prompt: Please find the visual event described by the sentence '{}', determining its starting and ending times. The format should be: 'The event happens in <start time> - <end time> seconds'.
timestamp_rule: Official processor; group representative endpoints produce center-of-group textual timestamps; each timestamp checked against group endpoints.
frames: Exactly the previous candidate frame indices, ATS groups and sparse selected indices.
resolution: Choose 32-pixel-grid aspect ratio with exactly the previous spatial tokens per group (Qwen2.5 patch14 -> Qwen3 patch16); resizing differs across architectures.
flexi_port: Port released training-free pseudo-inverse temporal-kernel resizing plus norm scaling to Qwen3 patch Conv3d; retain Qwen3 bias, DeepStack, position embeddings and textual timestamps. Not an official Qwen3 FlexiVideo checkpoint.
scope: Within-model comparisons; architecture, model size and image resize differ, so model-to-model changes are not a timestamp-only causal test.
native_visual_execution: Official unsplit native vision forward; variable-group path tested separately with native two-frame input. Earlier chunked-native preflight rejected before any prediction.
